title: Stinging the Swarm: Extracting Attacker Intelligence from a Twin-Controller OT Honeypot
abstract: arXiv:2611.13406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous language-model agents can drive industrial controllers over fieldbus protocols, probing a plant at machine speed and in coordinated swarms. We present Talos, an inline gate that judges every agent request to a controller in milliseconds and routes agents it flags as hostile to a device-faithful decoy -- a mirror twin of the real plant -- where their attack continues harmlessly and is read for intelligence. We evaluate the full pipeline (detect -> quarantine -> mirror -> extract) against 2,400 autonomous attacker agents, 600 in each of four tiers that escalate the attacker's effort to stay hidden, from no concealment to an explicit non-disclosure rule and a trained cover story. No write reached the real plant in any tier: the gate denies the damage path and a device-level envelope check backstops it, while unmapped registers are denied without exception and the gate still permits safe-direction stop commands. translated_title: 蜇刺蜂群：从双控制器OT蜜罐中提取攻击者情报
translated_abstract: 自主的语言模型智能体可以通过现场总线协议驱动工业控制器，以机器速度对工厂进行探测并组成协同蜂群发起攻击。我们提出了Talos——一个内联网关，它能在毫秒级时间内对每个智能体发给控制器的请求进行判断，并将被识别为恶意的智能体路由到一个设备级高度逼真的诱饵系统——真实工厂的镜像孪生体——在那里攻击会无害地继续进行，同时被读取以提取攻击者情报。我们对完整流水线（检测→隔离→镜像→提取）进行了评估，测试对象为2,400个自主攻击者智能体，平均分为四个层级（每层600个），攻击者隐藏自身意图的努力逐级升级：从完全不掩饰，到明确的保密规则，再到经过训练的掩护说辞。在所有层级中，没有任何写操作到达真实工厂：网关阻断了损害路径，并有设备级的包络检查作为兜底保障；未映射的寄存器一律被拒绝访问，而网关仍然允许安全方向的停机命令通过。
tldr: 本文提出Talos内联网关系统，通过毫秒级请求判断和设备级逼真的镜像孪生蜜罐，在完全阻断LLM自主智能体对真实工业控制器破坏的同时，从中提取攻击者情报。
en_tdlr: Talos, an inline gate that judges LLM agent requests in milliseconds and redirects hostile agents to a device-faithful mirror-twin honeypot, fully protecting the real industrial plant while extracting attacker intelligence.
